name: Viku Singh
install:
set -euo pipefail
NODE_VERSION=24.21.0
NODE_PREFIX=/usr/local/lib/nodejs
if ! "$NODE_PREFIX/bin/node" -v 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "v${NODE_VERSION}"; then
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz" -o /tmp/node-v24.tar.xz
  sudo mkdir -p "$NODE_PREFIX"
  sudo tar -xJf /tmp/node-v24.tar.xz -C "$NODE_PREFIX" --strip-components=1
  rm -f /tmp/node-v24.tar.xz
fi
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_PREFIX/bin/node" /usr/local/bin/node
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_PREFIX/bin/npm" /usr/local/bin/npm
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_PREFIX/bin/npx" /usr/local/bin/npx
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_PREFIX/bin/corepack" /usr/local/bin/corepack
printf 'export PATH="/usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin:${PATH}"\n' | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/nodejs.sh >/dev/null
export PATH="/usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin:${PATH}"
hash -r
npm ci
start:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin:${PATH}"
cd /workspace
if timeout 1 bash -c 'echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/3000' 2>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi
exec npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
